## Nous v0.1.1 — FYP demo (white screen fix)

Fixes the blank white window in the macOS release build.

### Download

| Platform | File |
|----------|------|
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `Nous_0.1.1_aarch64.dmg` |

### Install (macOS)

1. Download the `.dmg` below.
2. Open it and drag **Nous** to Applications (replace any older copy).
3. If macOS blocks the app, right-click **Nous** → **Open** → confirm.

### What's included

- NVIDIA AI included (no API key)
- Local vault, hybrid search, multi-agent research, Mission Control watches
